description: This file defines the Smarty_Internal_Resource_Registered class, which implements a custom resource handler for Smarty templates, providing methods for populating source metadata, retrieving timestamps, loading content, and determining basenames.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Resource_Registered
classes.description: Implements a registered resource handler for Smarty templates, facilitating resource metadata population, content retrieval, and timestamp management.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates the template source object with file path, unique id, timestamp, and existence status based on the resource.

methods.name: populateTimestamp
methods.description: Populates the source object with the latest timestamp and existence status.

methods.name: getTemplateTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the template's modification timestamp via a registered callback.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Retrieves the template source content via a registered callback, throwing exception if unable to load.

methods.name: getBasename
methods.description: Returns the basename of the resource's name for compiled filename purposes.
